title: The methane screen ran, but missed known observations

report.title: Methane Hunter: testing what the observations support

story.summary:
## Executive Summary

The pipeline analyzed **20 real NASA EMIT granules**, but its baseline did not pass the planned known-example recovery gate: only **1 of 2 positive scenes** had a documented-observation association. No independently corroborated new methane source was established.

- The 16 search granules produced **4 components**, all associated with published same-acquisition neighborhoods.
- Across every role, **14 components** received initial assessments: **6 E (documented neighborhood)** and **8 C (ambiguous)**. All eight C components came from the 23 March 2025 positive-validation scene. Components are not unique physical plumes or sources.
- The two catalog-negative controls produced zero baseline components over 572,084 usable pixel-observations; they are not guaranteed methane-free truth.

The main finding is a sensitivity limitation, together with a reproducible bounded search—not a regional completeness result.
story.results:
## Four search responses were already documented

The frozen sample spans **16 dates**, from 24 December 2023 to 22 September 2025, inside the northern Delaware Basin search box. The completed pipeline processed **15.9M usable pixel-observations**. This count retains repeated geography and is neither unique area nor 15.9M independent measurements.

The four baseline search components were all category E. Eight ambiguous components also remained in a known-positive scene. Their strong retrieval values warrant scrutiny, but existing spectral, surface, cloud or noise explanations have not been independently ruled out. Each component has a numeric dossier and a separate novelty assessment.
story.validation:
## The strict baseline missed known observations

On 23 August 2024 the baseline retained no components around four cataloged source heads. On 23 March 2025 it associated components with **1 of 10 heads** at 300 m. Two retained components associated with the same head, so component count cannot be equated with source count. Two of the first scene's four source-head pixels were quality-excluded; all ten in the second were usable. Downwind plume geometry can differ from head-pixel quality.

The prespecified three-times diagnostic associated **2 of 4 heads** in the first scene and **7 of 10** in the second; the seven-times diagnostic recovered none. In the first scene, three-times components intersected **2 of 3 NASA outlines**. The second exact-start-time NASA outline query returned none, which is a coverage limitation. The baseline remained five-times throughout.

Cloud-buffer exclusions, the sensor-noise threshold and the minimum connected support explain parts of the misses. These checks reuse the same retrievals and catalogs. They do not independently confirm methane or validate unmatched components.
story.access:
## The numeric investigation ran on full scenes

User-authorized Earthdata access resolved the initial anonymous download failure. All twenty frozen scenes were processed with V002 enhancement, sensitivity and uncertainty plus matching official quality data. Public catalog-selected plume crops were kept separate and were not used as neutral background or negative controls.

The input manifest retains source identifiers, URLs, content hashes and byte counts. Credentials are absent from the report and project artifacts.
story.methods:
## How the screen generated hypotheses

Corrected enhancement equals NASA CH4ENH divided by CH4SENS, in **ppm m**. Supplied UNCERT remains unchanged; NASA's actual processing expression already normalizes it for sensitivity. Official Cloud, Cirrus, Water, Spacecraft and Dilated Cloud flags were mapped by exact GLT correspondence. All 20 grid checks passed. Passing masks does not establish true gas.

The frozen screen required at least four 8-connected pixels above **max(500 ppm m, local background + 5 robust sigma, local background + 5 sensor uncertainty)**, with sensitivity>0.1. Local robust statistics used 128-pixel tiles. There was no smoothing or mask growth.

Catalog matching measured source-point-to-component-polygon distance in EPSG:32613, with empirical **300 m / 120-second** tolerances. The same photons underlie the catalog comparison, so agreement is documentation rather than independent corroboration. [NASA V002](https://doi.org/10.5067/EMIT/EMITL2BCH4ENH.002) and [MAPL-EMIT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10094v2) provide the scientific context; MAPL inference was not run here.
story.limitations:
## What remains uncertain

This provider-influenced convenience sample cannot establish regional catalog completeness. The failed positive gate makes the absence of novel search candidates especially uninformative about weaker emissions. A finite catalog, empirical matching tolerance and region boundary can all leave a previously documented feature unmatched.

All eight Category C responses remain ambiguous. The next useful check is an independent radiance/surface-context review, followed where possible by another sensor or near-coincident observation. No independent wind field, facility attribution, emission rate or annualization was produced. Re-thresholding is a robustness experiment, not independent evidence.
story.audit:
## Every component received a skeptical review

All **14** components passed the separate structural/provenance consistency checks, and all 14 numeric-data map panels were visually inspected. These checks do not establish atmospheric methane. Categories remained **6 E / 8 C**, with no A or B findings.

Two component pairs may be fragments of the same visible feature. Two C components lie 300–1000 m from a same-acquisition catalog source; one also has weak local-annulus contrast. Six components lie within 1.5 km of excluded-quality pixel centers, although no retained component contains excluded pixels. Proximity alone does not prove contamination.

The visual review found compact unresolved clusters and several elongated or fragmented features. No independent spectral fit, surface comparison, wind or another sensor resolved the alternatives. No repeated component neighborhood across dates was found in this sample; that absence does not establish transience or novelty.
story.reproducibility:
## The computation reproduced exactly

A complete local replay reproduced **20 scene-metric records** and the compared numeric, geometric and category fields for **14 components** exactly. The recorded essential suite passed **56 tests**, with 0 failures, 0 errors and 0 skips.

These are software and reproducibility checks. Repeating one implementation on identical observations does not provide independent methane confirmation.

rows.visual_note: One of two threshold fragments in an elongated feature near the same published source head. Components are not independent plume counts.
Adjacent to MH-02-0020 in the same elongated feature. Catalog association does not independently validate every surrounding pixel.
Compact isolated bright cluster with little visible extension. Noise and surface spectral effects remain unresolved.
Small compact cluster. The map alone does not establish plume morphology or a source.
Part of a broader elongated feature; a published source head is visible farther away. The weak local-annulus contrast and plume-tail/surface alternatives require further checks.
Small component near a cataloged source neighborhood and quality-excluded area. A separate emission cannot be inferred.
Compact component close to a quality-excluded region. Residual cloud/surface effects cannot be rejected.
One threshold fragment in an elongated feature also containing MH-02-0098. No wind or spectra establish methane or distinct source count.
Adjacent to MH-02-0097 in the same visible elongated feature. Fragmentation remains an alternative to two events.
Compact component near excluded/footprint-edge context; surface and retrieval artifacts remain unresolved.
Component overlaps published NASA plume-outline context. The map reproduces an existing observation, not independent confirmation.
Catalog-associated component close to the region boundary. Nearby source context extends outside the fixed study box.
Catalog-associated bright feature with broader enhancement around the threshold support. The screened polygon is not the full physical plume.
Catalog-associated component with nearby excluded footprint context. No facility or rate is inferred.
